messages.subject: Introducing myself
messages.body_plain:
Hi folks,

my name is Dietmar Janetzko. I am working as a lecturer at the School
of Computing
at the National College of Ireland in Dublin.

There are computer systems that lock you into one particular
intellectual level and others that help
you to go beyond that level - well ... if you are ready to overcome
some obstacles sometimes. R is definitively a
system of the latter kind. I use R for many years and I am struck by
the breadth of the various types
of analysis that are being developed under the R flag and which are
made available to the general audience.

My own work is related to data mining, statistics, social network
analysis and other data analysis areas
and I am looking forward to exchange R-related things with other like-
minded people.

Best

Dietmar

messages.subject: Re: introductions
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm a statistician/lecturer working in the areas of biochemistry,
clinical pharmacology and epidemiology.

I've been using R for several years and have a particular interest in
the GUI tools available in R (RGtk2, Qt, gWidgets,...), using them to
design GUIs for specific project related tasks, sometimes for
distribution within a project group.

Pat

messages.subject: Informal Meetup Tuesday 28th June Evening
messages.body_plain:
Hi, all,

Apologies for the short notice, but a few of us will be meeting up on
the evening of Tuesday 28th June for a casual get-to-know-each-other
sort of thing. Venue/exact time to be determined but probably a pub in
downtown Dublin where those who wish to can get food.

Don't worry if you can't make it, we'll probably be meeting up again
socially in late August and hopefully we will be starting to meet more
formally in September or October.

Please reply to this email with a +1 if you think you can make it on
Tuesday so I have approximate numbers, and of course if you know of
anyone who might be interested please ask them to join the group (or
just +2 on their behalf if that's easier).

ney), which is the pub-boat just opposite the new Conference Centre on

take the Red Luas to Mayor Square or Spencer Dock. My mobile is
0858063637. I'll be there from 6pm on.

-Ana
